newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end lower amid interest rate uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end lower amid interest rate uncertainty.

text.p: The threat of higher U.S. interest rates sent UK shares lower for the second day running on Tuesday, amid concern that fiscal policy may be tightened in Britain as early as next month, dealers said.
The FTSE 100 leading share index closed, which dropped nearly 50 points on Monday, ended 37.7 points down at 4,607.5.

"We've had a classic day of uncertainties. In this case it's about interest rates," the head of trading at a major brokerage said. "It's the fear of the unknown not the fact that has done the damage today."
